title: Feelings, Body, Family & Fairness

myths.myth: Big kids don't cry.
myths.truth: Everyone cries — even grown-ups.
myths.explanation: Crying lets big feelings out; it's healthy, not babyish.

myths.myth: Some feelings are bad.
myths.truth: All feelings are okay.
myths.explanation: Feelings aren't good or bad; what we do with them matters.

myths.myth: Boys don't get scared.
myths.truth: Everyone feels scared sometimes.
myths.explanation: Being brave can include feeling scared.

myths.myth: Being angry means you're naughty.
myths.truth: Anger is a normal feeling.
myths.explanation: We can calm it in small steps — breathe, count, tell someone.

myths.myth: Keep big feelings inside.
myths.truth: It helps to name a feeling and tell someone.
myths.explanation: Naming it makes it smaller; a trusted grown-up can help.

myths.myth: Grown-ups can touch you however they like.
myths.truth: Your body is yours — you can say no.
myths.explanation: Even grown-ups must ask; you're the boss of your body.

myths.myth: Private parts are rude to name.
myths.truth: Every body part has a real name.
myths.explanation: Knowing the right names keeps you safe and is never rude.

myths.myth: You must hug or kiss someone if they ask.
myths.truth: You can choose — a wave or high-five is fine.
myths.explanation: Your body, your choice, even with family.

myths.myth: If a touch feels wrong, keep it secret.
myths.truth: Tell a trusted grown-up.
myths.explanation: Secrets about touch aren't safe; it's never your fault.

myths.myth: Only strangers are unsafe.
myths.truth: Unsafe touch can come from anyone — tell someone.
myths.explanation: Most people are kind; trust the 'uh-oh' feeling and tell a trusted adult.

myths.myth: Washing your hands is fussy.
myths.truth: Washing washes germs away and keeps you well.
myths.explanation: Wash before food, after the toilet, and after play.

myths.myth: Keeping clean is a girls' thing.
myths.truth: Everyone looks after their body.
myths.explanation: Hygiene is for all kids.

myths.myth: Accidents are something to be ashamed of.
myths.truth: Accidents happen to everyone — it's okay.
myths.explanation: No shame; a grown-up helps you clean up.

myths.myth: Brushing teeth doesn't matter.
myths.truth: Brushing morning and night keeps teeth happy.
myths.explanation: Healthy habits help your body grow.

myths.myth: A real family is a mum, a dad and kids.
myths.truth: Families come in many shapes — all real.
myths.explanation: Single parents, grandparents, two mums or two dads, adopted families — all families.

myths.myth: Only mums look after children.
myths.truth: Anyone in a family can care.
myths.explanation: Dads, grandparents, everyone can look after a child.

myths.myth: Everyone loves their family the same way.
myths.truth: There are many kinds of love and many kinds of families.
myths.explanation: Love looks different in different families — all good.

myths.myth: Friends aren't family.
myths.truth: Family is the people who love and care for you.
myths.explanation: Family is about care, not just who you live with.

myths.myth: Those are boys' toys and girls' toys.
myths.truth: Toys are for everyone.
myths.explanation: Anyone can play with dolls, trucks, anything.

myths.myth: Pink is for girls, blue is for boys.
myths.truth: All colours are for everyone.
myths.explanation: Colours don't belong to a gender.

myths.myth: Boys and girls can't be friends.
myths.truth: Anyone can be friends.
myths.explanation: Friendship isn't decided by gender.

myths.myth: Being different is bad.
myths.truth: Everyone is different — and that's wonderful.
myths.explanation: We're all equal inside.

myths.myth: Girls are weak; boys are tough.
myths.truth: Strength and gentleness are for everyone.
myths.explanation: Anyone can be strong and kind.

myths.myth: Girls can't be pilots or engineers.
myths.truth: Anyone can do any job.
myths.explanation: What you can do isn't decided by being a girl or a boy.

myths.myth: Boys can't be nurses, dancers or cooks.
myths.truth: Any job is for anyone.
myths.explanation: Every job is open to everyone.

myths.myth: Some chores are for girls, some for boys.
myths.truth: Everyone can do every chore.
myths.explanation: Sharing chores fairly is for all.

myths.myth: Girls aren't good at sport or maths.
myths.truth: Anyone can be great with practice.
myths.explanation: Ability isn't a gender.
